[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Skilis''' was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Skilis commanded the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Kandarra]]''.<ref name="Shadows of Darkness" />
